description: This file defines a custom guardrail class for handling response modifications, violations, and guardrail configurations within a larger AI/ML project. It includes custom exceptions, guardrail application logic, logging, and content masking functionalities.

classes.name: ModifyResponseException
classes.description: A custom exception used by guardrails to carry a synthetic response, allowing responses to be modified or violations to be returned as successful responses.

classes.name: CustomGuardrail
classes.description: A class implementing guardrail logic, including violation handling, response validation, dynamic request modifications, logging, and guardrail execution control based on configuration, event hooks, and response types.
